verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot built into GitHub.com. It answers questions about your codebase, researches repositories and drafts implementation plans, and reviews code with one-click suggested changes. Copilot Autofix also proposes fixes for vulnerabilities, so AI suggestions grounded in the user's own repository data are delivered in-product. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI insights over non-code data (issues, projects, activity analytics), no independent or hands-on corroboration.
